about_the_game:
You've spent years building the hardest Futanari deck to get your hands on… and now it’s gone!

  • Someone had the audacity to hide your precious cards in the tightest corners of the house — and only you can stick your nose where it counts to get them back.

  • Explore fully interactive 3D rooms, digging into even the most suspicious holes.
    Under the bed, inside the closet, behind that perfectly placed bookshelf… the cards could be stuffed anywhere!

  • Recover each card and unlock teasing illustrations that'll make your deck stand tall with pride.
    Get ready for a naughty hunt full of hard-to-ignore surprises.

  • 100 Sensual cards

  • 7 Interactive rooms

  • Play with one hand

  • Controller support

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains erotic illustrations and suggestive images (including explicit nudity). Players should be aware that the game includes fantasy elements and adult themes.
